import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import colorsys
im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(float)/255.
r,g,b=im[...,0],im[...,1],im[...,2]
mx=im.max(-1);mn=im.min(-1);df=mx-mn
h=np.zeros_like(mx)
mask=df>1e-6
idx=(mx==r)&mask;h[idx]=((g[idx]-b[idx])/df[idx])%6
idx=(mx==g)&mask;h[idx]=(b[idx]-r[idx])/df[idx]+2
idx=(mx==b)&mask;h[idx]=(r[idx]-g[idx])/df[idx]+4
h*=60
s=np.where(mx>0,df/mx,0);v=mx
# olive green hue 55-175, sat > .13, value > .25
green=(h>=55)&(h<=175)&(s>0.13)&(v>0.25)
ys,xs=np.where(green)
print('green pixels',green.sum())
print('bbox x',xs.min(),xs.max(),'y',ys.min(),ys.max())
# cluster by connected components simple: print coordinate list grouped
import collections
pts=set(zip(xs,ys))
seen=set();comps=[]
for p in list(pts):
    if p in seen:continue
    stack=[p];comp=[]
    while stack:
        q=stack.pop()
        if q in seen:continue
        seen.add(q);comp.append(q)
        qx,qy=q
        for dxy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            nq=(qx+dxy[0],qy+dxy[1])
            if nq in pts and nq not in seen:stack.append(nq)
    comps.append(comp)
comps.sort(key=len,reverse=True)
for c in comps[:8]:
    cx=[p[0] for p in c];cy=[p[1] for p in c]
    print('comp size',len(c),'x',min(cx),max(cx),'y',min(cy),max(cy))
\""
